remarks: Harbor View Auto Sales LLC presents a strong, well-established opportunity for a buyer seeking both retail and service income streams. The business has been successfully operating for many years as a used car dealership, complemented by a highly profitable and reputable service department. In addition to steady vehicle sales, the service side of the business provides consistent, recurring revenue and a loyal customer base. The sale also includes a large inventory of Matco tools, offering significant added value for an incoming owner. Harbor View Auto Sales benefits from a reliable flow of used vehicle sales and a solid presence in the local market, making it an ideal turnkey operation with proven performance and growth potential.
